intro.text: Karpathy 用 Opus 5 + 100 万 token 预算渲染《指环王》开场的三维 JS 场景（9895 赞，今日最高）。Sottiaux 预告周末的 10 个重大突破（4939 赞）+ /fast 周末使用减少（4263 赞）。Peter Yang 火辣点评 Opus 5 不如 Opus 4.6（1160 赞）+ 治愈癌症的愿望（751 赞）。Amanda Askell 罕见地发了一条深座（1306 赞）：不要对说深度学习碰壁的人不友善。我们都需要一点希望。Altman 只发了一个词（2253 赞）：team humanity。Rauchg 推开源 agentic CRM（861 赞）+ 习惯与子女（831 赞）。Levie 论 AI 能力分化（347 赞）。Garry Tan 论 OpenAI 成为开放平台（278 赞）。Steipete 让 agent 装邮箱插件（239 赞）+ ESP32 语音唤醒（257 赞）。播客是新的：No Priors 采访 Netic 创始人 Melisa Tokmak，论为真实世界服务构建自主企业。

sections.title: Karpathy's 3D Render & The Deep Learning Debate / Karpathy 三维渲染与深度学习争论
sections.desc: Karpathy 用 Opus 5 + $10 渲染《指环王》开场（9895 赞）；Amanda Askell 谈壁垒论者的善意（1306 赞）；Levie 论能力分化（347 赞）；Altman team humanity（2253 赞）。

cards.authorTag: OpenAI co-founder / Anthropic / Box CEO / OpenAI CEO

rewrite: Karpathy's 3D render (9895 likes): 'We're starting to leave the territory where you'd test an LLM by creating an SVG of a pelican on a bicycle. I gave Opus 5 the first paragraph of Lord of the Rings, a 1M token budget (~$10), and asked for a three.js render of it.' Pushing the boundaries of what constitutes an LLM benchmark.

Amanda Askell's rare personal post (1306 likes): 'Do not be unkind to those who say deep learning is hitting a wall. We all need a little hope in our lives.' Plus her Padme moment on permanent underclass (821 likes) and altered carbon meme (213 likes).

Levie on capability divergence (347 likes): 'We're going to see an increasing divergence between what AI does in personal lives vs. deep domains like math, science, legal, coding.' Altman's one-word post (2253 likes): 'team humanity.'
original: Andrej Karpathy: We're starting to leave the territory where you'd test an LLM by e.g. "create an svg of pelican on a bicycle". I gave Opus 5 the first paragraph of Lord of the Rings, a 1M token budget (~$10) and asked for three.js render of it.
Amanda Askell: Do not be unkind to those who say deep learning is hitting a wall. We all need a little hope in our lives.
Aaron Levie: We're going to see an increasing divergence between what AI does in our personal lives and in daily productivity vs. what it can do in very deep domains.
Sam Altman: team humanity.

rewrite: Karpathy 的三维渲染（9895 赞）：我们正在离开用 SVG 鹝鸟骑自行车测试 LLM 的时代。给了 Opus 5《指环王》第一段 + 100 万 token 预算（约 $10），让它用 three.js 渲染。推动了 LLM 基准测试的边界。
Amanda Askell 罕见的个人发文（1306 赞）：不要对说深度学习碰壁的人不友善。我们都需要一点希望。加上她对永久底层阶级的 Padme 时刻（821 赞）和凗热师归来的 meme（213 赞）。
Levie 论能力分化（347 赞）：AI 在个人生活中的作用将与在深度领域产生越来越大的分化。Altman 只发了一个词（2253 赞）：team humanity。
original: Andrej Karpathy：我们正在离开用 SVG 鹝鸟骑自行车测试 LLM 的时代。给 Opus 5《指环王》开场 + 100 万 token。
Amanda Askell：不要对说深度学习碰壁的人不友善。我们都需要一点希望。
Aaron Levie：AI 能力将在个人生活和深度领域产生分化。
Sam Altman：team humanity。

sections.title: Sottiaux's Weekend Teaser & Peter Yang's Opus 5 Critique / Sottiaux 周末预告与 Peter Yang 点评 Opus 5
sections.desc: Sottiaux 预告 10 个突破（4939 赞）+ /fast 周末减少（4263 赞）；Peter Yang 火辣点评 Opus 5（1160 赞）+ 癌症愿望（751 赞）。

rewrite: Sottiaux's weekend teaser (4939 likes): 'The week was for efficiency. The weekend is for 10 major breakthroughs in science. There will be signs.' Plus his observation (4263 likes): 'Fun fact, users use /fast less during the weekend. The weekend is for relaxation, even for the model.'

Peter Yang's spicy take (1160 likes): 'Opus 4.6 was the Opus model with the best personality and writing style. Something's off with Opus 5 - overly long replies, too much Claude-speak, too judgemental.' Plus his heartfelt wish (751 likes): 'The number one thing I want AI to fix is to cure cancer once and for all.'

Thibault Sottiaux: Fun fact, users use /fast less during the weekend. The weekend is for relaxation, even for the model.
Peter Yang: I think Opus 4.6 was the Opus model with the best personality and writing style. Something's off with Opus 5.

rewrite: Sottiaux 的周末预告（4939 赞）：工作日是为了效率。周末是为了科学的 10 个重大突破。将会有迹象。加上他的观察（4263 赞）：有趣的发现，用户周末更少使用 /fast。周末是用来放松的，即使对模型也是。
Peter Yang 火辣点评（1160 赞）：我认为 Opus 4.6 个性和写作风格最好。Opus 5 有些不对——回复太长、Claude 腐语太多、太爱下判断。加上他的心愿（751 赞）：我最想 AI 解决的第一件事是彻底治愈癌症。

sections.title: Swyx, Nikunj & Nan Yu: Loops, Tokens & ROI / Swyx、Nikunj 与 Nan Yu：循环、代币与 ROI
sections.desc: Swyx 的会议回顾（53 赞）；Nan Yu 的 GitHub 代币折标想法（28 赞）；Nikunj 论模型扩散与 ROI 的荒谬世界（3 赞）。

rewrite: Swyx on conference talks (53 likes): reviewing talks 24/7 after the show, highlighting 'fighting slop with slop' and BTaylor's ask for an AI-native programming language. Plus clanker blog decisions and 5.6 one-shotting tasks.

Nan Yu's GitHub token pledge idea (28 likes): 'You should be able to pledge tokens for issues in open source repos. Write a spec with a pledge. If maintainer accepts, GitHub passes the issue to a cloud coding agent at requester's expense. No more slop PRs.'

Nikunj on the dichotomous world (3 likes): 'Models solving NP hard problems while traditional enterprises still complaining about their ROI on token spend. Diffusion of models is all we'll be doing for the next few decades.'
original: Swyx: one of my curses as organizer is i rarely get to attend the conference i run.
Nan Yu: You should be able to pledge tokens for issues that you open in open source repos. No more slop PRs.
Nikunj Kothari: Models solving NP hard problems while traditional enterprises still complaining about their ROI on token spend.

rewrite: Swyx 的会议回顾（53 赞）：作为组织者很少能参加自己的会议，24/7 回看演讲。推荐「用垃圾打败垃圾」和 BTaylor 对 AI-native 编程语言的期待。
Nan Yu 的 GitHub 代币折标想法（28 赞）：你应该能够为开源 issue 押代币。写规格 + 押金。如果维护者接受，GitHub 把 issue 传给云编码 agent，费用由请求者承担。不再有垃圾 PR。
Nikunj 论荒谬世界（3 赞）：模型在解 NP-hard 问题，而企业还在抱怨 token 花费的 ROI。未来几十年就是模型扩散。

Nan Yu：为开源 issue 押代币。写规格 + 押金。不再有垃圾 PR。
Nikunj Kothari：模型解 NP-hard，企业抱怨 ROI。未来就是模型扩散。

sections.title: Podcast: Netic CEO on Autonomous Enterprise for Real-World Services / 播客：Netic CEO 论为真实世界服务构建自主企业
sections.desc: No Priors 采访 Netic 创始人 Melisa Tokmak：为 HVAC、宠物护理、屋顶等真实世界服务构建自主企业。完整 transcript（38477 字符）已翻译。

rewrite: No Priors: Elad Gil interviews Melisa Tokmak, founder and CEO of Netic. Netic builds AI to run millions of real-world businesses (HVAC, pet care, roofing, hospitality). 70%+ of customers' first interaction is with Netic AI. Key topics: why essential services are neither 'old school' nor easily replaced by robotics, how PE's playbook is changing from cost-cutting to revenue generation, screening for agency in hiring, her journey from a small Turkish town to Stanford to Scale AI to founding Netic. Over $600M generated for customers from AI-handled interactions.
original: Melisa Tokmak: Netic builds AI to run millions of real world businesses that keep the world running.
Melisa Tokmak: Over 70% of our customers are AI first. All of their customers' first interaction is with Netic agents.
Melisa Tokmak: Being a founder, I actually think was a more honorable thing before. You knew you're dedicating your life to it.
Melisa Tokmak: We have made so far over $600,000,000 for our customers from AI handled interactions.
Melisa Tokmak: The Christian shoemaker doesn't honor God by putting little crosses on the shoes, but by building the best shoe.

rewrite: No Priors：Elad Gil 采访 Netic 创始人 Melisa Tokmak。Netic 为 HVAC、宠物护理、屋顶、客房服务等真实世界行业构建 AI。70%+ 的客户第一接触是与 Netic AI 交互。核心话题：机器人在这些领域还很遥远、PE 的 AI 转型、如何筛选主动性、从土耳其小镇到斯坦福到 Scale AI 再到创业。Netic 已为客户从 AI 交互中创造超 6 亿美元收入。
original: 【Netic 是什么】
Tokmak：Netic 为运转世界的数百万真实世界企业构建 AI。涵盖 HVAC、管道、电工、宠物护理、屋顶、客房服务。
「70%+ 的客户第一次互动是与 Netic agent 交互。」
「我们在企业和它的客户之间。理解客户需求、匹配服务、部署劳动力都在 Netic 上完成。」
【为什么不做滚动收购】
Tokmak：三个原因。一，我想建设的东西。二，我是工程师和产品人，不是 M&A 人。三，规模——滚动收购只能服务买来的公司，而 Netic 希望每个真实世界企业都能跑在我们的平台上。
【机器人还很遥远】
Tokmak：看看窗外的每一栋建筑。如果机器人要做我们今天做的事，每栋建筑都需要 3D 打印或完全标准化。
「在这些行业里，很多时候是客户人生中最糟糕的一天。家里洗浡了，或者想去湾俱乐部放压力。人性化的元素很重要。」
【私募基金的变化】
Tokmak：以前是找到被低估的宝石，换团队，卖掉。现在这种宝石不存在了。
「他们的第一反应总是削减成本。但我不是来削减成本的。我是来创造新收入的。」
「如果我们只用 AI 削减成本，那将非常悲哀。」
【招人哲学：筛选主动性】
Tokmak：我的经典面试问题是“你做过最难的事是什么？”不限于工作，可以是任何事。
「不是只看一个主动性例子，而是你活了多久，就一直在展示主动性。你是否坚持了？」
「基督徒不是在鞋子上画十字来荣耀上帝，而是做最好的鞋子。上帝在乎的是工匠精神。」
【个人故事与愿景】
Tokmak：我在土耳其的小镇长大，家里没什么钱。来美国只是因为斯坦福的全额奖学金。之前从没拥有过电脑。
「我最兴奋的是教育。它将改变很多人的生命，那些否则不会知道这个世界存在的人。」
「每个人口袋里都有一切。但即使如此，保证你，大多数人仍然不会做出那个选择。」
